VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields are invalid — check them and try again
MALFORMED_REQUEST: The request could not be read — reload the page and try again
SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has expired — sign in again
FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to this action
EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Verify your email address first — open the link we sent you
DEMO_RESTRICTED: Turned off for the shared demo accounts
DEMO_READ_ONLY: Showcase listings are read-only — add a listing of your own to edit, publish and upload photos
RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: The requested item was not found
CONFLICT: This conflicts with existing data — reload and try again
CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION: This record was changed by someone else — reload and try again
VIEWING_SLOT_TAKEN: Someone just booked this time — pick another slot
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This request was already sent with different data
RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Too many attempts — try again in {minutes} minutes
UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: A service we depend on is unavailable — try again later
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side — try again later

auth.currentPasswordWrong: The current password is not right
auth.samePassword: Choose a password different from the current one

listing.publishNotAllowed: This listing can't be published while it is {status}
listing.unpublishNotAllowed: This listing can't be unpublished while it is {status}
listing.suspendNotAllowed: This listing can't be suspended while it is {status}
listing.notEditable: This listing can't be edited while it is {status}
listing.publishNeedsPhoto: Add at least one photo before publishing
listing.cityNotFound: Choose a city from the list
listing.tooManyPhotos: A listing can have at most {max} photos
listing.tooManyPendingUploads: Too many uploads in progress — finish them or try again later (at most {max} at a time)
listing.photoTooLarge: A photo can be at most {maxMb} MB
listing.photoNotUploaded: The photo was not uploaded — try again
listing.photoRejected: The file is not the photo that was announced — upload a JPEG, PNG or WebP
listing.photoOrderMismatch: The order must list every photo once — reload and try again

message.notConfirmed: Messages open once the lister confirms the viewing
message.closed: This conversation is closed — the viewing was cancelled
message.threadFull: This conversation is full ({max} messages) — continue by email

registration.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists — sign in instead

verification.alreadyVerified: This email address is already verified
verification.invalidLink: This link is not valid any more — ask for a new one

savedSearch.tooMany: You can keep at most {max} saved searches — delete one first

viewing.noSchedule: This home has no viewing hours yet — contact the lister instead
viewing.slotUnavailable: This time is not available — pick one of the offered slots
viewing.alreadyActive: You already have a viewing of this home — cancel it before asking for another
viewing.tooMany: You can have at most {max} upcoming viewings — cancel one first
viewing.notCancellable: This viewing can't be cancelled any more
viewing.scheduleNeedsWindow: Open at least one day with viewing hours
